author: GG-EZ
quote:
You see FF15 skips the prologue because Square decided to make it a movie, so you begin the game not knowing what is going on. You are thrown in this open world that is empty. There are barely any NPC's, only 1 town and several gas stations. That is all there is for the majority of the game.

You go from gas station to gas station doing busy work. You pick a hunt, go kill the random monster then to the next gas station. Finally you get to the one and only town in the game, a really tiny town. There for the first time you hear about what happened to your hometown, the events of the movie, and they don't show you even a single cut-scene, just some radio station talking about it and a piece of paper.

Then some aid from Noctis' father appears and tells you need to go raid these 8 temples to get some swords in order to beat the bad guy. Now instead of gas station to gas station picking hunts now you go from temple to temple. These temples are dark, linear and practically as dull and empty as the open world itself. After like 30 hours playing this shtty game you finally get all the swords. Then you get on a boat to a city, then a train and then a time skip to the end of the game.

This was the vanilla experience but then there is Royal with a bunch of Dlc. You had to wait like a year for the Ardyn Dlc to finally get to know who the fck the main baddy of the game even was... Crazy right? It was that bad. The rest of the Dlc are all disconnected from the game and focus on the other 3 characters accompanying Noctis. It all take place during the time skip of the main game.

Overall combat is trash press one button win. And I'm not exaggerating when I say you cannot lose in this game. Because if you do the game allows you to use one of your 99 potions or even call a summon to finish the fight for you 99% of the time. Characters are trash with no depth. Story is absolute trash and barely told within the game. FF15 was not a good game. Easily one of the worst games in the series.
